notes.title: Fix Timer2
notes.content: Fixed timer starting when you pause before the waves start.

notes.title: Fix Timer on Pause
notes.content: Fixed issues with the timer when pausing the game.

notes.title: Fix Instructions
notes.content: Fixed some issues with the instructions in level 1 and 2.

notes.title: Update 1: Infinite mode!
notes.content:
[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Infinite mode (for every level!).
[*] Send waves early (for speedrunners!).
[*] Best time and max waves are saved.
[*] Shop to buy and equip towers (better player progression).
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Mazing issues where vehicles would get stuck if the path is only one square wide.
[*] Better performance when a lot of vehicles are present.
[/list]
